SELECT diagram_id, member_id, diagram_title, diagram_description, diagram_type, version_number, use_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM diagrams
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, diagram_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT diagram_id, member_id, diagram_title, diagram_description, diagram_type, diagram_model, version_number, use_yn, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM diagrams WHERE diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagrams (member_id, diagram_title, diagram_description, diagram_type, diagram_model, version_number) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{diagramTitle}, #{diagramDescription}, #{diagramType}, #{diagramModel}, 1)

INSERT INTO diagram_versions (diagram_id, version_number, diagram_title, diagram_type, diagram_model, change_summary, changed_by) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{versionNumber}, #{diagramTitle}, #{diagramType}, #{diagramModel}, #{changeSummary}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT diagram_version_id, diagram_id, version_number, diagram_title, diagram_type, change_summary, changed_by, created_at FROM diagram_versions WHERE diagram_id = #{value} ORDER BY version_number DESC

SELECT diagram_version_id, diagram_id, version_number, diagram_title, diagram_type, diagram_model, change_summary, changed_by, created_at FROM diagram_versions WHERE diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND version_number = #{versionNumber}
